edges.description: Developmental eye defects arise downstream of altered ZNF526 function.
Abnormal brain development contributes to early severe developmental delay.
Impaired neurodevelopment leads to severe intellectual disability.
Abnormal brain growth contributes to severe microcephaly.
Cortical developmental abnormality contributes to simplified gyration on neuroimaging.
Brain developmental abnormality contributes to epileptic seizures.
Abnormal brain development contributes to the epileptic encephalopathy phenotype.
Brain developmental abnormality contributes to limb hypotonia.
Brain developmental abnormality contributes to hypertonia and hypertonic-dystonic movements.
Brain developmental abnormality contributes to hypertonic-dystonic movements.
Developmental eye abnormalities contribute to bilateral cataracts.

nodes.description: The syndrome prominently affects central nervous system and cerebral cortical development, producing severe prenatal/postnatal microcephaly, cortical gyral simplification, epileptic encephalopathy, and motor/cognitive impairment.

evidence.snippet: RESULTS: We identified five patients from four unrelated families with homozygous ZNF526 variants by whole exome sequencing. Four had variants resulting in truncation of ZNF526; they were affected by severe prenatal and postnatal microcephaly (ranging from -4 SD to -8 SD), profound psychomotor delay, hypertonic-dystonic movements, epilepsy and simplified gyral pattern on MRI.
